'''S.C. Faetano''' is a [[San Marino|Sanmarinese]] [[football (soccer)|football]] club, based in [[Faetano]]. The club was founded in [[1962 in association football|1962]]. Faetano currently plays in [[Campionato Sammarinese di Calcio]], the only football league of San Marino. The team's colours are yellow and blue."}}
